text:
nina: quick ping 11 - customers seeing intermittent fallback to v1 after v2 handshake. peeking at edge logs shows cookie set but subsequent requests often lack it. quotas look split.

paul: any client-side proxies known to drop cookies? or new edge behavior?

nina: sample: Set-Cookie: __rwd_aff=xyz; Max-Age=30 then 2nd request (same token) -> no cookie header, served v1.

sara: sounds like cookie-based stickiness is unreliable for some CDNs. we should fallback to token->route mapping when cookie missing. also fix telemetry to attribute by token hash so billing doesn't double-count.

kevin: agreed. I'll add a "route-affinity-loss" panel and alert (threshold 0.3%). ops-bot, any recent routing deploys?

ops-bot: deploy: routing-edge:release-2026.03.14 applied to edge-us-1 at 2026-03-14T08:00Z by @release-ci

paul: plan: 1) add token->route fallback (hotfix) 2) add metric attribution change 3) surface SDK advisory about preserving headers. aim: hotfix in 3h.

nina: thanks, will monitor and keep support looped in.
